arguments.premise_synthesis: Gold tends to anticipate monetary policy in advance, as demonstrated by the 2019-2020 cycle where gold started a bull market in June 2019 ahead of money printing and peaked in August 2020 before easing began. Gold broke out in 2024 in anticipation of future easing. However, current discussions of easing measures (deregulation, yield curve control, rate cuts) are juxtaposed with war-driven inflation that could force tighter policy, leading to a re-pricing of gold downward.
